Hi all 

quick technical write-up and proposed plan from my side. Short answer up front: recommend Mistral-7B-Instruct (quantized) as primary for the POC and Llama-2-13B (8-bit) as the higher-accuracy fallback if latency and budget allow. Rationale and plan below.

Model recommendations (POC stage):
- Primary: Mistral-7B-Instruct (quantized to 4-bit or nf4 where possible)
  - Pros: Strong instruction-following for zero-shot/low-shot prompts, compact for faster latency on 1-2 GPU profile, cost-efficient. Good multilingual transfer for Spanish with instruction finetuning.
  - Cons: May occasionally underperform on very long policy retrieval synthesis compared to larger models.

- Fallback / Variant: Llama-2-13B (8-bit)
  - Pros: Better factual consistency and long-form synthesis; strong multilingual baseline when using a lightweight Spanish adapter or in-context examples.
  - Cons: Higher memory footprint and slower p50 latency; requires slightly larger infra.

Multilingual approach:
- For English + Spanish we will: (a) use the primary model (Mistral-7B-Instruct) with bilingual prompt templates and language detection routing; (b) if we see Spanish-specific performance issues, route Spanish prompts to the fallback model for A/B comparison; (c) consider a small adapter/LoRA trained on 5-10k Spanish QA pairs if needed.

Evaluation plan (what we'll run during the POC):
1) Baseline pass: run sample-prompts.csv across both models to collect accuracy/precision/recall on intent + retrieval.
2) Hallucination audit: apply a strict hallucination heuristic (source grounding required for policy lookups) and flag items for manual review (we'll mark outputs missing citations or asserting unverifiable facts).
3) Latency/cost profiling: continuous load with representative prompt lengths to measure p50/p95 latency and per-1k-token cost estimate.
4) Qualitative review: 10-person internal review panel to rate helpfulness and safety on a 5-point scale.

Success metrics (aligned to your ask):
- Intent precision >= 92% (on holdout)
- Hallucination rate < 5% on policy lookups (manual audit)
- Latency p50 < 500ms on the primary infra profile (subject to model and batch configuration)

Proposed POC timeline (accelerated):
- Day 0: receive sanitized 200-sample set, finalize environment access.
- Day 1-2: baseline runs (both models) + initial latency profiling.
- Day 3-7: A/B testing and iterative prompt tuning; run Hallucination audit samples.
- Day 8-14: Larger sample runs, qualitative panel, compile results and recommendation.
